publication.title: ComBiNet: Visual Query and Comparison of Bipartite Multivariate Dynamic Social Networks
publication.version: HAL author version of 2023 CGF article

source_reading.scope: Abstract/introduction, collaboration/data-model description, visual/text query and provenance (§4), implementation (§4.4), use cases, formative study (§6) and limitations (§7).

adjudication.basis: The implemented visual/Cypher query and comparison interface operates on typed persons, documents/events and role relations stored in Neo4j. This is a domain property graph with semantic attributes, so eligibility is supported if the review covers such domain KGs alongside RDF; it should not be called an RDF or general-purpose KG browser.
